GLIBC-SA-2026-0024 (CVE-2026-97399) is a one-byte overread in the Power8-specific strncasecmp optimization (BZ #34683). DHI pkg-glibc rebuilds target linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only, so that Power8 implementation is not present in published glibc debs. See https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=blob;f=advisories/GLIBC-SA-2026-0024

DHI Node packages reset bundled zlib's input state after direct-buffer gzwrite errors, preventing stale caller-owned pointers from reaching gzprintf or gzvprintf. Node 24 and 26 apply upstream zlib commit https://github.com/madler/zlib/commit/df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148 directly; Node 22 applies the equivalent reset in its older zlib 1.3.1 error branch.
